chunks: 1352 - Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:

“A man should not refrain from saying at the time of his sleep: I seek protection for myself, my offspring, the people of my household, and my wealth through the perfect words of Allah, from every Shaytan, every harmful creature, and from every afflicting eye.”
For that is what Jibrāʾīl, peace be upon him, used as protection for al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn, peace be upon them.

key_terms.بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ: through the perfect words of Allah as a means of seeking protection
key_terms.شَيْطَانٍ: a devil from whom protection is sought
key_terms.مَنَامِهِ: the time of going to sleep
key_terms.هَامَّةٍ: a harmful creature or dangerous being

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be said before sleep for protection over oneself and one’s family?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a specific du'a to be recited before sleep for seeking Allah’s protection over oneself, one’s descendants, family, and wealth. It also connects this formula of refuge to Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام and his protection of al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام, showing its noble precedent and recommended use.
